Roe.Title: RoE Violation
Roe.VictimSteps:
1. Review the loss you suffered carefully.
2. Are you certain it wasn't a zero node? Open the attacker's chat to verify this.
3. Contact the attacker directly and ask for clarification. Give them a few hours to respond.
4. If no agreement is reached, post screenshots with all relevant information here. This includes the battle, the battle log and your communication with the player.
Roe.OffenderSteps:
1. Contact the affected party directly and settle the incident by mutual agreement.
2. If no agreement is reached, post screenshots with all relevant information here. This includes the battle, the battle log and your communication with the player.
